questions.stem: Why do elements in the same group have similar chemical properties?

options.text: Because they have the same number of electron shells
Because they have the same number of outer shell electrons
Because they have the same atomic mass
Because they have the same number of neutrons

questions.explanation: Elements in the same group have the same number of electrons in their outer shell. Chemical reactions involve outer shell electrons, so elements with the same outer shell configuration react in similar ways.
